name: com.gameframex.unity.objectstorage
description:
GameFrameX ObjectStorage — base interfaces and abstractions for cloud object storage operations. Defines IObjectStorageManager for uploading and downloading files and directories in both runtime and editor, Option-style parameter classes (ObjectStorageOptions / ObjectStorageUploadOptions / ObjectStorageDownloadOptions), the BaseObjectStorageManager abstract base class for custom implementations, and the ObjectStorageManagerFactory static factory for creating manager instances. Provider-specific implementations (ALiYun OSS, Qiniu Cloud, Tencent COS) are available as separate packages. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX ObjectStorage — 对象存储（云文件存储）操作的基础接口与抽象功能包。定义在运行时与编辑器均可用、支持文件与目录上传下载的 IObjectStorageManager，Option 风格参数类（ObjectStorageOptions / ObjectStorageUploadOptions / ObjectStorageDownloadOptions），供自定义实现继承的 BaseObjectStorageManager 抽象基类，以及创建管理器实例的 ObjectStorageManagerFactory 静态工厂。阿里云 OSS、七牛云、腾讯云 COS 等服务商实现以独立功能包提供。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
